finding: Generic still allocator writes next, publishes PSTATE head, then count/length/header; body is caller-filled
hazard: There is no durable per-operation intent or ACK; current sequence is not the selected initialized-before-head profile
proposedReplacement: Controlled allocator prepares body/intent privately, atomic controlled-domain head, adapted setup/sweep readers; raw legacy chain remains separately admitted

finding: still list/queue and RC chain are per-PSTATE; ALLOC_MEM_LOCK protects capacity
hazard: A scalar memory lock or processor number is not stable domain/writer ownership
proposedReplacement: VM-owned domain incarnation and writer lineage; never hold a nonrecoverable lock across interruption assumed recoverable

finding: Existing still marking uses CAS; header selects compiler builtins/emulated/sequential synchronization
hazard: Current CAS helper existence proves neither atomic object ABI nor owner-death progress for a new head/decision cell
proposedReplacement: New native atomic profile explicitly binds all loads/stores, alignment and backend; emulate only with separately qualified stop-safe lock behavior

finding: Setup walks raw still head/next and resets marks; barrier precedes marking
hazard: Observer bypasses managed commit/lease cut if only allocator is changed
proposedReplacement: Controlled-domain iterator acquires frozen complete head after publisher closure; all domains setup before any mark

finding: Sweep reads next, relinks live objects and recomputes per-PSTATE counts
hazard: Next cannot be rewritten by late helper after sweep starts; source head equality alone lacks ABA protection
proposedReplacement: No-future-write closure of all lineages before sweep; controlled/legacy/pending accounting reconciled without dual authoritative counters

finding: POSIX starter invokes start_fn; ___thread_exit calls pthread_exit; ___run return can continue sync service loop
hazard: Logical Scheme/processor task completion is not native thread termination
proposedReplacement: Distinguish activation-close/cooperative operation endpoint/native termination; certificate identifies exact native incarnation and scope

finding: POSIX join wrapper branches on pthread_join return, converts error through errno helper; helper maps errno0 to UNKNOWN_ERR
hazard: Original pthread error value is not retained; success/failure and target identity must remain explicit, not inferred from errno or absence
proposedReplacement: Store exact raw join return and successful target incarnation in service receipt; no stopped certificate from ignored/failed/unknown join

finding: Shrinking processor cleans PSTATE then exits; P0 joins and ignores result
hazard: Recovery after successful join is too late if PSTATE cleanup already freed operation/node/root backing
proposedReplacement: Transfer VM-owned construction/domain duties before cleanup; consume exact join receipt after known quiescence; failed join retains removal debt

finding: cleanup_os_and_mem_pstate calls memory cleanup; still/RC freed; VM teardown destroys synchronization
hazard: Native stopped does not reconstruct freed objects or recover a destroyed domain lock
proposedReplacement: Service backing/roots/code outlive PSTATE; never issue takeover from join alone after storage destruction

finding: setjmp/longjmp TRY machinery and SFUN error loops reuse marker; ___call consumes exact matching return frame
hazard: C stack local progress can disappear; logical unwind does not fence every native helper or foreign writer
proposedReplacement: Off-stack operation/intent/result and explicit guarded no-future-write endpoint; native return rights still belong to original live activation

finding: Generator emits native entry wrappers; source and generated kernel read marker slots
hazard: Unmigrated raw producer can write after token checks; changing generation does not revoke issued stores
proposedReplacement: Typed Scheme-generated entry/closure descriptors and complete raw-writer census; regenerate or reject old module profile

finding: Old allocation changes scalar occupied/deferred words; resize request combines and temporarily assumes live space
hazard: Repeating scalar delta after lost commit can charge/refund twice; temporary requested words are not operation outcome
proposedReplacement: One canonical allocation ticket role derived from decision; summary counters are reconciled views, never second outcome authority

finding: Marker proc copy has GC TODO; dynamic closure uses global self; RC roots per PSTATE, mark_rc only P0 branch
hazard: A stopped native writer and correct head do not establish root completeness or original closure identity
proposedReplacement: Pre-backed actual input root, stable handle in decision, all-domain root view and legacy marker gate imported unchanged

finding: Native allocation/free can use malloc or mmap backend; void release hides outcome
hazard: Commit reconciliation cannot recover unknown native allocation or infer munmap success
proposedReplacement: Retain exact pending/quarantine ticket; no allocation/free in reconciliation, backend-specific original evidence still required

finding: Real Tcl command/server/function-valued callbacks instantiate generated native entry and return paths
hazard: Nested callback/delete/error can close logical activation while cleanup result persists
proposedReplacement: Keep activation/root/native-resource duties separate from canonical commit, no foreign continuation compatibility assumed

finding: GSTATE exposes raw marker and thread functions; teardown can destroy storage independent of external handles
hazard: Plain external pointer or reused thread id cannot validate late query; metadata reclamation is separate from heap collection
proposedReplacement: Protected lookup/pin and nonreused operation/writer identities; stable decision/root backing until data writers/readers drain
